assets.subject: Fictional adult Omani professional in dishdasha and kumma, office with Omani architectural details
assets.generator: Canva generate-image (connected Canva integration), aspect LANDSCAPE_16_9
assets.prompt: Premium three-dimensional illustration for a website hero. A fictional adult Omani professional man wearing an authentic white dishdasha with a short tassel (farrukha) and an embroidered Omani kumma cap, standing calmly in a bright modern office with Omani architectural details: sandstone walls, a pointed arched window, a carved wooden door pattern. He holds a tablet and looks friendly and composed. He stands in the right third of the frame; the left half is calm, softly lit sandstone and ivory wall with generous empty space for website headings. Soft warm studio lighting from the upper left, realistic proportions, refined matte materials. Colour palette: sandstone, ivory, emerald green, turquoise, restrained copper accents. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no flags, no emblems, no government insignia. Not a real or identifiable person.
